share.local: a machine's own runner: a linked office sees its jobs on «כל מקביל» and asks for named jobs through the job door (DGO-1797, its own package)
Its API is this office's offices, links, pairing and stored logins, never handed to a peer (DGO-624); a linked office gets only its catalog, on the link's own control door.
Error reports carry this office's stack traces and request data, secrets in their context among them: each office keeps its own, and none is read across a link.
A coding agent that runs code in this office's workspace with a container runtime: served on a link, it would hand another office code execution here.
Recipes with no service of their own, so there is nothing to serve: a linked office reads the same recipes from its own copy of the source.
Docker management is root on this office's engine: it never crosses a link.
Raw access to the cache and the queues, sessions and tokens among them: it never crosses a link.
The database's own studio and REST API reach every table of this office, unscoped: data crosses a link only through an app's own API.
